text.text_excerpt: My husband and I visited this hotel a few years ago for a spring break trip. Our seven year wedding anniversary is coming up this June and I am very excited to be headed back to The Place d'Armes! The hotel is very old but in my opinion this only adds to its charm. The rooms are small but very clean. Same to be said about the bathrooms small, but clean, and well decorated. Last time we visited we had a room with a partial view of Jackson Square and The Cathedral. When we stay in June we will be in a interior room with no windows. I love this hotel. It is truly our home away from home in New Orleans. We have stayed here so many times that we feel like we should have our own room. Too bad they don't do timehshare! It is the perfect location in the French Quarter, right at Jackson Square. Because of the fantastic location we never feel unsafe walking to/from our hotel no matter what time. If you are looking for high style and luxorry accomadations, then look elsehwere. THe Place D'armes is comfortable, clean, and as far from cookie cutter hotel as you can get. We chose to stay here for our first trip to NOLA based on price and location. We weren't sure exactly what to expect but we couldn't have been more pleased! This hotel was so full of character and completely charming. The courtyard area (including outdoor pool) was absolutely beautiful. The pool was a bit small but it was never crowded. We stayed in a courtyard room. We did not have a private balcony but we had a sitting area outside our door on a shared balcony overlooking the courtyard. We also had access to a balcony overlooking the street which was fun to see. Our room, although missing any modern updates was clean and cozy. I loved the exposed brick on the outside wall.
